slides.title: Pave motion audit
slides.subtitle: Every place in the front end where something moves, read and scored against one motion language.
slides.byline: Real work · figures from the published write-up
slides.notes: About 750 transitions and animations across about 350 stylesheets, which became 47 proposed fixes.

slides.text: The same spinner ran at four different speeds.
slides.notes: Its keyframes had been copied from file to file. A slow spinner makes the app feel slow at the same load time.

slides.title: Every stylesheet read, not sampled
slides.source: Pave motion audit, Quickbase, 2026. Figures as published in the write-up; internal names removed.

present.notes: Each site was scored on duration, easing, the property animated and reduced motion.

slides.title: One spinner, four speeds
slides.intent: One rotation, measured in each copy of the keyframes.
slides.source: Pave motion audit, Quickbase, 2026. Figures as published in the write-up; internal names removed.

steps.say: The fix: one shared keyframe at 0.8 s.

present.notes: Whatever your spinner is made of, define its speed once.

slides.title: Toast enter: today and proposed
slides.source: Pave motion audit, Quickbase, 2026. Figures as published in the write-up; internal names removed.

steps.say: The default ease speeds up before it slows down, so entrances feel late.
Shorter, and fastest at the start.

present.notes: Duration ruler: 20 cells of 25 ms on a fixed 500 ms scale. Speed glyph: progress in each eighth of the time.

slides.title: Eight characters per curve
slides.intent: Speed over time for each easing in the audit.
slides.source: Pave motion audit, Quickbase, 2026. Figures as published in the write-up; internal names removed.

steps.say: A spring: the visible motion is over in a quarter of the time; the rest is settling.

slides.title: Overlaps nobody saw in review
slides.source: Pave motion audit, Quickbase, 2026. Figures as published in the write-up; internal names removed.

steps.say: Two animations on the toast overlap by 40 ms, and the pulse never stops.

slides.title: The hero cut against the product
slides.intent: The marketing hero drifted all the time; the product grid mostly holds still.
slides.source: Hero animation handoff, 60-second recordings of both versions, every line position logged per frame.

steps.say: Always moving, against moving a quarter of the time.

present.notes: A measurement, not an opinion. Ten cells is enough for the comparison.

slides.text: One duration scale, one easing set, one spinner speed.
slides.notes: And the glyph code got tests: it had shown the wrong easing name on 25 of the 47 findings.
